raw_title: Book Review: ‘Living With Freddie,’ by Anna Heyward
description: In “Living With Freddie,” Anna Heyward recalls the pet who taught her “to be human.”
In an impressive change of pace, Emma Cline’s new novel gets inside the head of a stoic businessman with dementia.

raw_title: Book Review: ‘Tower Hill,’ by Alan Taylor
description: In “Tower Hill,” the Pulitzer Prize-winning scholar Alan Taylor pulls apart the twisted logic of a Virginia slave owner and his descendants.
